0022600167.text: The Celtics, who are 5-1 overall, 4-0 at home, and riding a five-game winning streak, make their seventh game of the season at the Rockets, who are 6-1 with a 3-0 home record and a one-game win streak. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Boston's 114-93 win in Houston on February 4, 2026 being the most recent meeting.
